command: echo ts=$(date -u +%FT%TZ); systemctl show doso-robot-cloud-gateway.service -p ActiveState -p MainPID -p StateDirectory -p FragmentPath -p DropInPaths --no-pager; echo state; stat -c '%n mode=%a size=%s mtime=%y' /var/lib/doso-cloud/reporting.json /etc/doso/robot-cloud/gateway/reporting.json 2>&1; echo state_dir; stat -c '%n mode=%a owner=%U:%G' /var/lib/doso-cloud 2>&1; echo hashes; sha256sum /var/lib/doso-cloud/reporting.json /etc/doso/robot-cloud/gateway/reporting.json 2>&1
